name: Can Gio food guide
summary: Order lẩu cá dứa on đường Duyên Hải and đường Tắc Xuất, then walk to chợ hải sản Hàng Dương for live seafood beside bãi 30 tháng 4. The mangrove plates are the mudskipper salad, lá lìm kìm, ba khía with lá buôi, and straw-grilled duck at Vàm Sát.
body: The sit-down streets are đường Duyên Hải and đường Tắc Xuất, in the old Cần Thạnh town, now xã Cần Giờ. Dân Việt, on 2 Oct 2022, puts lẩu cá dứa nấu măng chua there, with the simmered fish, tôm tích, and the shellfish. The market is separate: chợ hải sản Hàng Dương on đường Thạnh Thới, about 50 m from the sand in a Thanh Niên story of 11 Mar 2019. You point at a live animal and the stall cooks it, or you take a pan already on the fire.

Ho Chi Minh City is the long meal. Here the plates are mangrove and coast. VnExpress, on 22 Sep 2021, describes gỏi lá lìm kìm with fried cá bống sao. Dân Việt, on 28 Apr 2024, describes gỏi cá thòi lòi. Khô cá dứa is the thing people carry home. Salt from the pans is the other thing people carry home.
Sài Gòn Giải Phóng, on 17 Feb 2014, says much of the coast is nghêu beds and that the silt from the Đồng Nai and the Soài Rạp is why the seafood grows fast and tastes sweet.
specialtiesLead: Lẩu cá dứa and khô cá dứa come first. The mangrove plates, the fruit, and rượu mật ong rừng Sác follow.

sections.heading: Seafood
paragraphs: These are the seafood plates the newspapers name. Dân Việt also lists lẩu cá ngát, cá bóp, and cá mao with the other pots.

spots.name: Lau ca dua
spots.address: Đường Duyên Hải and đường Tắc Xuất
spots.note: Lẩu cá dứa nấu măng chua is a southern sour-sweet hotpot of sea catfish and bamboo shoot. The flesh is sweet, the skin is smooth and fatty, and you finish the fish with nước mắm, chili, and a little bún.

spots.name: Ca dua kho
spots.address: Đường Duyên Hải and đường Tắc Xuất
spots.note: Cá dứa kho is the same sea catfish, simmered and eaten with rice. The flesh is firm and a little fatty.

spots.name: Kho ca dua
spots.note: Khô cá dứa is sea catfish split, salted, and dried for one sun. The flesh fries or grills to a deep yellow, firm, with only a little fat under the skin.

spots.name: Tom tich
spots.note: Tôm tích, also called tôm tít, is a large mantis shrimp cooked with burnt garlic. The meat is sweet, and a small shell leaves little of it once you crack it.

spots.name: Tom
spots.nameVi: Tôm sú, tôm sắt, tôm đất
spots.note: Most of the prawns here are tôm sú, from the sea or from ponds. Tôm đất has a soft clear shell and chewy sweet meat, and tôm sắt has a hard shell.

spots.name: Oc len
spots.address: Hàng Dương, or the town streets
spots.note: Ốc len is a mangrove snail, on the town menu and at Hàng Dương as ốc len xào dừa.

spots.name: Goi chua oc dun
spots.note: Gỏi chua ốc đụn is a sour salad of ốc đụn.

spots.name: Oc giac
spots.note: Ốc giác is a sea snail with a chewy, crisp bite.

spots.name: Oc huong
spots.address: Town streets in 2022. No street in 2014.
spots.note: Ốc hương biển hấp sả is a spotted sea snail steamed with lemongrass. The meat is cleanly sweet and tastes of the sea.

spots.name: Oc mo
spots.address: Hàng Dương in 2019. No street in 2014.
spots.note: Ốc mỡ is cooked as ốc mỡ xào me and as ốc mỡ rang me. The snail is sweet and soft.

spots.name: So huyet
spots.note: Sò huyết is a blood cockle, cooked from the live shell, including the town plate sò huyết la cót.

spots.name: Vop
spots.address: Đường Duyên Hải and đường Tắc Xuất
spots.note: Vọp, also written dọp, is a large shellfish eaten with mỡ hành and peanuts, or grilled. It is not too chewy.

spots.name: Hau nuong
spots.address: Chợ hải sản Hàng Dương, đường Thạnh Thới
spots.note: Hàu nướng is an oyster grilled in the shell, with cheese or with mỡ hành.

spots.name: Ca duoi hap
spots.address: Đường Duyên Hải and đường Tắc Xuất
spots.note: Cá đuối hấp hành is stingray steamed with onion. Diners also eat the fatty liver.

spots.name: Lau ca duoi
spots.address: Đường Duyên Hải and đường Tắc Xuất
spots.note: Lẩu cá đuối is a stingray hotpot with vegetables, sour bamboo, cần cà, or ngót.

spots.name: Cua um
spots.address: Đường Duyên Hải and đường Tắc Xuất
spots.note: Cua um chua ngọt is a sour-sweet crab braise.

spots.name: Cua cum
spots.note: Cua cúm is a mangrove crab with a black body and a rough shell. The meat is firm and fragrant.

spots.name: Ghe
spots.address: Hàng Dương, or the town streets
spots.note: Ghẹ is the swimmer crab visitors ask for at Hàng Dương, also served as ghẹ nấu bầu. Some shells are red-pink and some are green, and the meat is firmer in the last days of the lunar month.

sections.heading: Mangrove plates, fruit, and a drink
paragraphs: Dân Việt, on 28 Apr 2024, and VnExpress, on 22 Sep 2021, name the leaf, the mudskipper, the duck, and the mangrove crab. Sài Gòn Giải Phóng, on 17 Feb 2014, names the mango and the custard apple.

spots.name: Goi ca thoi loi
spots.note: Gỏi cá thòi lòi trộn lá lìm kìm is a salad of mangrove mudskipper and lá lìm kìm. The fish is sweet, fragrant, and soft, against a sour, slightly astringent leaf.

spots.name: Goi la lim kim
spots.note: Gỏi lá lìm kìm is a salad of a small watery mangrove vine, with cá bống sao fried crisp or with dried fish. It is salty and sour, with a sweet finish that changes with the rain and the hour.

spots.name: Canh la lim kim
spots.note: Canh lá lìm kìm is a soup of the same mangrove leaf with tôm and tép. The leaf is already salty and the shrimp is sweet, so the pot takes no added salt.

spots.name: Canh chua ca khoai
spots.note: Canh chua cá khoai is a sour soup of a long, round fish with pineapple, tamarind, tomato, bean sprouts, ngổ, and spring onion. The flesh is soft and translucent, and the bowl smells of pineapple and tomato, sweet, then cleanly sour.

spots.name: Vit nuoc man
spots.note: Vịt nước mặn is a brackish-water duck from Vàm Sát, grilled in straw and eaten with a pepper and lemongrass dip. The meat is firm, fresh, and naturally sweet, and low in fat.

spots.name: Ca doi muoi hot
spots.note: Cá đối nổ muối hột is mullet buried in coarse salt and cooked by the heat of the salt as it pops. The flesh stays moist and tastes of coarse salt and lemongrass, then goes into rice paper with forest leaves.

spots.name: Sam trung nuong
spots.note: Sam trứng nướng is horseshoe crab grilled on charcoal, then shredded with its eggs, spring onion, garlic, chili, cilantro, and crushed peanuts. The eggs are fatty and the meat is sweet.

spots.name: Lau ba khia
spots.note: Lẩu ba khía lá buôi is a mangrove-crab hotpot with a fatty, clean-sweet crab riêu. The leaf, also called rau bộ đội, is nutty and wants a thorough cook.

spots.name: Dia sam
spots.note: Địa sâm is eaten fresh, grilled, stir-fried, fried, or as porridge, and dried to sweeten a cooking liquid. It is naturally sweet.

spots.name: Ruou mat ong
spots.note: Rượu mật ong rừng Sác is a honey wine drunk with the mudskipper salad.

spots.name: Xoai cat
spots.note: Xoài cát Cần Giờ is the Hòa Lộc mango grown on this coast, round and yellow. It is cool-sweet, and the soil and the care make it different from the same variety elsewhere.

spots.name: Mang cau
spots.note: Mãng cầu here is not very large, with thick flesh that is chewy and sweet. The taste follows the sandy coastal soil.

sections.heading: Casual dining
paragraphs: Hàng Dương is the market by the sand. Duyên Hải and Tắc Xuất are the sit-down streets.

spots.name: Hang Duong seafood market
spots.address: Đường Thạnh Thới, xã Cần Giờ
spots.note: Thanh Niên, 11 Mar 2019, puts the market on đường Thạnh Thới in the old xã Long Hòa, beside bãi 30 tháng 4, about 50 m from the sand. You choose sò, ốc, cua, ghẹ, tôm, or mực, and the stall cooks it, or you take a pan already on the fire. That story says a cook fee of 10,000 VND a kilogram for steaming and 30,000 for rang muối, cháy tỏi, xào dừa, xào bơ, xào me, nướng mỡ hành, nướng phô mai, and nướng mọi. VnExpress, updated 28 Feb 2025, names the same cooks plus hấp xả lá chanh, and says the cook-to-order cost is a few tens of thousands of đồng. A busy day in the 2019 story meant a wait of about 30–40 minutes. One seller said she sold from about 7:00 until about 21:00, and that the seafood had come in that morning at Cầu Cảng.

spots.name: Duyen Hai and Tac Xuat
spots.nameVi: Đường Duyên Hải và đường Tắc Xuất
spots.address: Xã Cần Giờ, the old Cần Thạnh town
spots.note: Dân Việt, 2 Oct 2022, sends you along Duyên Hải and into Tắc Xuất toward the sea for lẩu cá dứa and tôm tích.

seoTitle: Can Gio food guide — lau ca dua and Hang Duong
seoDescription: Lẩu cá dứa on Duyên Hải and Tắc Xuất, and live seafood at Hàng Dương. Mangrove salads, ba khía, and one-sun khô cá dứa.
